chinese: 取天下常以无事，及其有事，
pinyin: Wèi xué rì yì， wèi dào rì sǔn。
Sǔn zhī yòu sǔn， yǐ zhì yú wú wèi。
Wú wèi ér wú bù wèi。
Qǔ tiān xià cháng yǐ wú shì， jí qí yǒu shì，
Bù zú yǐ qǔ tiān xià。
english:
One who seeks knowledge learns something new every day.
One who seeks the Tao unlearns something new every day.
Less and less remains until you arrive at non-action.
When you arrive at non-action,
nothing will be left undone.

Mastery of the world is achieved
by letting things take their natural course.
You can not master the world by changing the natural way.
